evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce PRISM, a tile-level benchmark that measures the reliability of pathology foundation models along four axes: model choice, label fraction, calibration, and out-of-distribution transfer.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Pathology foundation models are typically benchmarked on classification performance at full label availability and on in-distribution test sets, while calibration, behavior at low label budgets, and robustness under cross-institutional shift are seldom evaluated jointly.
